figurative_meaning_en: spoiled or ruined due to excessive indulgence or leniency
similar_in_english: spare the rod and spoil the child
give an inch and take a mile
example_sentences_in_bangla: আদরে বাঁদর করে ছেলেটাকে নষ্ট করে ফেলেছো।
এই প্রশ্রয়ে সে আদরে বাঁদর হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: You've spoiled the boy by pampering him like a monkey.
With all this leniency, he has turned into a spoiled brat.
history: This idiom draws from folk observations of monkeys in rural Bengal, which become unruly when fed or pampered by humans, symbolizing how indulgence leads to mischief.
note: The extended form 'আদরে বাঁদর বনে' emphasizes the transformation into wild behavior.
